research.notes:
**Window: 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-29. Most items below fall outside the window. I flag those as context, and I found nothing material for several topics.**

## 1. Guidance
- No new guidance or pre-announcement in the window. The operative Q3 2026 guide is net revenue of RMB1,100–1,150m (+38–45% YoY), given with Q2 results — 2026-08-18 (context) — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001861737/000110465926098050/tm2623467d1_ex99-1.htm
- On that same call, Hesai raised its 2026 SGI (new-business) revenue guide to RMB200–300m from RMB100m. It reiterated full-year lidar shipments of 3–3.5m units — 2026-08-18 (context) — https://www.tradingkey.com/news/transcripts/262115870-tradingkey
- Hesai announced it will report Q3 results on Nov 10, before the US open — 2026-10-20 — https://investor.hesaitech.com/news-events/news-releases
- Q2 revenue was $126.7m against a $126.0m estimate. EPS was $0.01 against a $0.07 consensus — 2026-08-18 (context) — https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/price-hesai-group-nasdaq-hsai-reaches-new-52-week-low-heres-why-2026-10-22/

## 2. Analyst actions
- Weiss Ratings cut HSAI to "hold (c-)" from "hold (c)" — 2026-10-08 — https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/consensus-hesai-group-sponsored-adr-nasdaq-hsai-stock-has-average-target-price-of-2350-according-to-analysts-2026-10-18/
- Wall Street Zen upgraded HSAI to "sell" from "strong sell" — 2026-10-03 — same URL.
- I found no named broker upgrades, downgrades or price-target changes in the window.

  - StockAnalysis shows "Strong Buy" and a $26.66 target from 19 analysts — as of 2026-10-28 — https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/hsai/

## 3. Litigation and regulation
- Nothing new in the window.
- Context: on 2026-08-18 the D.C. Circuit unanimously held that the Pentagon violated Hesai's due-process rights over its 1260H "Chinese military company" listing. It remanded the case but did not immediately order delisting — https://www.globaltimes.cn/page/202608/1368546.shtml
- The same source says DOJ stated the Pentagon had delisted Hesai on the original grounds but planned to relist it on newer information. The source gives no date for that statement. Global Times is Chinese state-linked media, and the report relays Hesai's own statement.
- An aggregator snippet describes a US review of Chinese lidar for cybersecurity risk. It gives no date and I couldn't verify it — date unknown — https://alphai.io/stock/HSAI

writeup.headline: Hesai rates Hold: rapid revenue growth and net cash offset by weak margins, dilution and a falling share price.
writeup.thesis: Hesai earns a Hold with a composite score of 56. Growth scores the maximum: TTM revenue growth of 52.1%, and growth sped up by 44.5 pp from the previous quarter. The balance sheet also scores the maximum, with cash at 6.54 times debt and 24.7 years of cash at the current burn. Those strengths are held back by quality, which scores 34 on an operating margin of 5.6%, an FCF margin of -6.3% and a diluted share count up 13.3% year on year. Trend scores 0, with the price 52.0% below its 52-week high and the shares 47.0 pp behind SPY over the last 126 trading days. Valuation could not be scored because the foreign-filer share and currency data were not reconciled, so the rating rests on the other five factors.
key_risks: Negative free cash flow (FCF margin of -6.3%) despite fast revenue growth
Shareholder dilution, with the diluted share count up 13.3% year on year
Weak price trend: price 30.8% below its 200-day average and shares down 35.0% from 12 months ago to 1 month ago
Competition from RoboSense and lidar pricing pressure, plus reliance on Chinese automakers
Background regulatory risk from the 1260H listing dispute, including possible relisting
what_would_change: A score gain of 9 points would reach Buy at 65, most likely from a recovering price trend or better margins and cash flow lifting the quality score
A drop of 12 points would push the stock below 45 into Sell, for example if growth slows sharply or news turns negative
The Q3 results due Nov 10, compared with the RMB1,100–1,150m guide, could move the growth and news factors either way
